dataset_name: Japanese Learning Platform AI Evaluation Dataset
quality_notice: This expanded dataset is generated from curated seed examples and controlled variants. It is suitable for pipeline testing and preliminary model comparison, but must be reviewed by a qualified Japanese-language reviewer before being treated as a gold-standard benchmark. Repeated seed sentences across variants are intentional for prompt/criterion coverage and are not 1,000 fully independent linguistic items.
evaluation_policy: Never use exact string match as the sole metric for translation or open-ended generation.
Separate deterministic checks from semantic judging.
Store model output, judge output, prompt version, model version, latency and token usage separately.
Keep a held-out test split that is not used for prompt tuning.
Report score by task, JLPT level and error category.
Human-review a stratified sample and all disputed/low-confidence cases.
